intent: In cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/launch/launch.py's service_spawn, the systemd-run branch adds -p CollectMode=inactive-or-failed when the env handed to the unit carries CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID, restoring for superclaude.py the mark the shell superclaude gave a test run's units (ef541167c:cairn/devices/cc/superclaude:623-624; the prior orient for f04d5ef26a48's ask, orient-20261005T214203-6c951759bdb9, is the same aim at the shell). A new proof at the launch tool spawns a failing argv with and without the id.
request: launch.service_spawn starts a unit whose env carries CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID with CollectMode=inactive-or-failed, so a test run's failed unit is collected; outside a run the default is kept.
scope: IN: launch.py's service_spawn systemd branch (its reset-failed retry reuses the same cmd) and the new proof cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/launch/proofs/test_a_test_run_unit_is_collected_when_it_fails.py. OUT: superclaude.py and every caller (e179281f6eff's); the setsid and Windows branches (they start no unit); scoped_argv/scoped_exec; the existing launch proof (read only, must stay 4/4).
unknowns: whether any service_spawn caller in a test run passes the test id only through os.environ rather than env= (superclaude.py passes it in env=; it is the only non-proof caller measured)
